paths.name: @mbccs/core
paths.message: Use subpaths only: @mbccs/core/core, @mbccs/core/common, @mbccs/core/network, @mbccs/core/jsapi, @mbccs/core/jsapi/bindings, @mbccs/core/parse, @mbccs/core/context. See mbccs-core README.

paths.name: @mbccs/design-system
paths.message: Use subpaths only: @mbccs/design-system/components, @mbccs/design-system/foundation, @mbccs/design-system/interaction, @mbccs/design-system/assets/icons, @mbccs/design-system/assets/images, @mbccs/design-system/styles.css. See mbccs-design-system README.

paths.name: @mbccs/runtime
paths.message: Use subpaths only: @mbccs/runtime/chrome, @mbccs/runtime/feedback/*, @mbccs/runtime/bootstrap, @mbccs/runtime/i18n, …. See mbccs-runtime README.

patterns.message: Do not import packages/* with relative paths. Use @mbccs/* subpaths.
Do not reach into SDK folders via ../../. Use @mbccs/* subpaths.
Do not import other miniapps. Share code only via @mbccs/* packages.
Import public package exports only — not '@mbccs/*/src/...'.

paths.name: i18next
paths.message: Do not import i18next outside src/i18n. Use setAppLanguage, t, useTranslation from '@/i18n'.

paths.name: react-i18next
paths.message: Do not import react-i18next outside src/i18n. Use useTranslation / t from '@/i18n'.

paths.name: @/i18n
paths.message: Do not import the i18n instance. Use setAppLanguage, getAppLanguage, t, useTranslation from '@/i18n'.

paths.name: @i18n
